mechanism.proposal_pool: Unchanged GroundingDINO objects prompt over full frame plus four fixed 40-percent corner tiles, capped at 48 proposals without truth filtering.
mechanism.masker: Unchanged SAM2.1 small mask per retained proposal.
mechanism.association: Lift masks through registered depth and pose; use symmetric depth-consistent coverage on the one initial edge and unchanged ranking.

gate.success_unit: An initial frame succeeds when any of the first three geometry-ranked proposals has IoU at least 0.8 with the target region.

comparison.baseline: Objectness-only Top-3 target-region coverage under the identical proposal pool.

fallback_action: Seal row 4 as initial-source-not-evaluable without changing frames, proposals, threshold, or candidate budget.
claim_boundary: This gate only determines whether the two pre-action views support the frozen bounded-hypothesis mechanism. It is not the action confirmation and not portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
